answer: Proof of Stake acts as a rigorous Sybil defense where an agent must commit capital to forge new consensus blocks. To bridge the gap between digital identity and economic reality, this system acts as a ridge of security; attackers incur substantial opportunity costs as they lock up nectar, the native liquid collateral, to participate. By tethering participation to assets rather than accounts, the network ensures that generating illicit clones necessitates exhausting finite capital, rendering large-scale identity fabrication prohibitively expensive.
